title: fix(ci): let the owner's @claude comments start the on-demand review
body:
## What

The `on-demand` job in `.github/workflows/claude-review.yml` now starts when the comment's author **login** is `csdev19`. Before, it started only when `author_association == 'OWNER'`.

## Why

This repository belongs to the `niway-dev` organization. On an organization repository, GitHub reports the owner's comments as `MEMBER`, not `OWNER`. As a result, **every `@claude` comment was skipped**. Example: run [39648100277](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/actions/runs/39648100277), triggered by a `@claude review …` comment on [#364](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/364), finished as `skipped`.

Matching the login keeps the documented rule ("only the owner's `@claude` comment starts a run", ADR 0028). It is stricter than accepting `MEMBER`, which would let any organization member start a paid run. `scripts/claude-review.ts` already trusts `OWNER`, `MEMBER` and `COLLABORATOR` replies inside threads, so nothing else changes.

`issue_comment` workflows always run the version of the file on `main`. That means this fix only takes effect after it merges. The review kit was copied from `niway-dev/pr-review-engine`, so the same check probably needs fixing there too. I have not checked that repository.

## How to test it yourself

1. Merge this PR.
2. On [#364](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-record/pull/364), comment with the scoped review command. That PR is too large for a full review: about 3,000 of its lines are Drizzle snapshots.
   ```
   @claude review apps packages/application packages/infra-db/src/schema packages/infra-db/src/repositories packages/infra-db/src/integration packages/infra-db/src/migrations/0000_baseline.sql packages/infra-db/src/migrations/0001_integrity.sql packages/infra-db/src/migrations/0002_account_provider_unique.sql packages/infra-db/drizzle.config.ts scripts .github package.json CLAUDE.md README.md
   ```
3. In Actions → "Claude PR review", the `Claude on demand` job must **run**, not show as skipped. A review from `github-actions` must then appear on #364.
